sources.snippet: The frontend uses existing common csrc operations without changing their symbols or behavior. Native-only operation gaps live under csrc/native_cpp/, are linked only by an enabled native target, and are not added to the Python kernel modules. They are model-independent operation implementations; PI0.5 model order, dimensions, state rules and checkpoint mapping remain under cpp/models/pi05/.
